author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA override λ0.605 kd22 k50 δ0.10 (DAQB)
abstract: Ridge-override baseline using MPB-GraphFWPCA with fixed λ=0.605 and DAQB graph (k=50, kd=22, δ=0.10, cap=2.0). Produces X_emb and batch-corrected graph; targets established SOTA parity.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.10,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=50,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
